rationale: A two fragment Gibson assembly: 150 bp of the CBh promoter record and 180 bp of the CMV promoter record. The designer composes 20 bp terminal homology arms, both junctions are distinct, both overlaps melt above the 48 C floor, every primer sits inside the Tm, GC, length and structure windows, and both amplicons are inside the PCR size window. Fifteen checks apply and all fifteen pass. Every sequence in this case is a plus strand slice of a real GenBank record already in this repository, at the offset the fragment source field records. The offsets are chosen, the bases are not. hairpin_engine is pinned to window in every assembly gold case. ViennaRNA is an optional import that is not in requirements.txt, so leaving the engine on auto would make the verdict depend on whether the package happens to be installed, which section 3.3 constraint 1 forbids for a gold set.
